prog='''def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h=len(g); fc=g[0][0]
    w=0
    while any(g[i][w]==fc for i in range(h)): w+=1
    glyphs={}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w,len(g[0])):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v: glyphs.setdefault(v,set()).add((i,j))
    def norm(cells):
        mi=min(c[0] for c in cells); mj=min(c[1] for c in cells)
        return frozenset((c[0]-mi,c[1]-mj) for c in cells)
    gshapes={v:norm(c) for v,c in glyphs.items()}
    seps=[i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==fc for j in range(w))]
    out=[row[:w] for row in g]
    for a,b in zip(seps,seps[1:]):
        if b>a+1:
            hole=frozenset((i,j) for i in range(a+1,b) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==0)
            hs=norm(hole)
            col=[v for v,s in gshapes.items() if s==hs][0]
            for i,j in hole: out[i][j]=col
    return out
'''
